description: This Java class `ProductAttributeEntity` extends `ProductAttribute` and represents an entity related to product attributes, including properties such as price, weight, sort order, and default status. It provides getter and setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: ProductAttributeEntity
classes.description: A Java class that models product attribute data including price, weight, sort order, and default indicator, extending the `ProductAttribute` class and implementing `Serializable`.

methods.name: setProductAttributePrice
methods.description: Sets the price of the product attribute.

methods.name: getProductAttributePrice
methods.description: Returns the price of the product attribute.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order for the product attribute.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the sort order of the product attribute.

methods.name: setProductAttributeWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight of the product attribute.

methods.name: getProductAttributeWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight of the product attribute.

methods.name: setAttributeDefault
methods.description: Sets whether this attribute is the default.

methods.name: isAttributeDefault
methods.description: Returns whether this attribute is marked as default.
